entries.claim: The ordinary least squares coefficient vector minimising the residual sum of squares is beta-hat = (X'X)^{-1} X'y, assuming full column rank
entries.locator: James et al., An Introduction to Statistical Learning, Chapter 3

entries.claim: The variance inflation factor equals 1/(1 - R_j^2), where R_j^2 comes from regressing predictor j on the others, and it measures how much the coefficient variance is inflated by collinearity
entries.notes: VIF definition and the common VIF>10 rule of thumb

entries.claim: With exactly two predictors the VIF equals 1/(1 - rho^2) and the coefficient standard error scales by sqrt(VIF)
entries.notes: Direct consequence of the VIF formula for a single regressor, used in the interactive demo

entries.claim: AIC = -2 ln L + 2k and BIC = -2 ln L + k ln n trade goodness of fit against the number of parameters, and BIC penalises extra parameters more strongly for n > 7
entries.notes: Original definitions of the two information criteria

entries.claim: Stepwise selection is data-driven and makes reported p-values and confidence intervals selective, so it tends to overfit and is hard to reproduce
entries.locator: ISLR Chapter 3, discussion of model selection
entries.notes: Motivates preferring domain knowledge plus cross-validation

entries.claim: Salary slopes of 1.9 and 1.2 wan yuan per year before and after adding education years, and the VIF table values, are constructed teaching numbers
entries.notes: Not drawn from any real survey

entries.claim: The fitted-plane figure, the collinearity variance figure and the interaction figure are teaching diagrams prepared for this lesson
